summary: Independently verified all three proposal citation ranges and all three non-retain claims in canonical vi1101.c. Proposal and functionality agree: static slots are distinct from resource lifetime, and locked Luigi branch does not clear its pointer. Accept compiled-layout deferrals; source declarations cannot establish either 32-byte extent. Inherited retained knowledge remains unchanged; rendered external names were not used as proof.

proposed_facts.reason: Independently read every cited canonical range. The declarations establish static-storage pointer slots and the eight-byte buffer; entry populates both scene descriptors and archive handles. Participant setup assigns Mario unconditionally and Luigi only in the unlocked branch, without a clearing else branch. No local buffer consumer or teardown appears. The proposal meaningfully corrects resource-lifetime wording without asserting compiled section extent, and agrees with functionality.md.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral of fact:f28a7fbd-96c8-4a94-809b-1c909f82f739: separate source declarations do not establish a contiguous 32-byte compiled .sbss layout. No compiled-layout conclusion is adopted.
Accepted deferral of fact:c48122e4-1b15-4065-9d5a-efffd3a734e1: the authored floating-point constants cannot establish a 32-byte compiled .sdata2 literal-pool extent without pinned compiled evidence.

Accepted supersession of fact:c258e419-6bf6-47a9-8a09-df446c454dd0 by proposal fact 0. Static storage duration must not be equated with sequence resource lifetime. Luigi's retained pointer is conditionally assigned and not cleared when locked. Cross-scene resource validity and teardown remain explicitly deferred rather than inferred.

unresolved: The asserted 32-byte .sbss layout and 32-byte .sdata2 literal-pool extent lack pinned compiled evidence.
Resource teardown and validity across scene transitions are not established by this unit; static pointer storage must not be equated with resource lifetime.
Exact historical inferred-name spellings remain uncertain. Rendered Player_SetMetalFlag and other external semantic substitutions are not independent evidence for numeric-state meanings.
